label: open all git-modified files
command:
set -o pipefail
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && cd -- "$root" || exit 1
git status --porcelain=v1 -z --no-renames --untracked-files=no | (
  files=()
  while IFS= read -r -d '' entry; do
    filename=${entry:3}
    if [[ ${entry:0:2} == *M* && -f "$filename" ]]; then
      files+=("$filename")
    fi
  done
  if (( ${#files[@]} )); then
    zed -- "${files[@]}"
  fi
)

label: github: open commit
command:
set -o pipefail
blame=$(git blame -L "$ZED_ROW,$ZED_ROW" --porcelain -- "$ZED_FILE") || exit 1
sha=${blame%% *}
if [[ $sha != *[!0]* ]]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'The selected line is uncommitted.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
repo=$(git remote get-url origin | sed -E 's#^(https?://|ssh://git@|git@)github\.com[:/]##; s#\.git$##') || exit 1
gh browse --repo "$repo" "$sha"

label: github: open PR
command:
set -o pipefail
blame=$(git blame -L "$ZED_ROW,$ZED_ROW" --porcelain -- "$ZED_FILE") || exit 1
sha=${blame%% *}
if [[ $sha != *[!0]* ]]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'The selected line is uncommitted.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
repo=$(git remote get-url origin | sed -E 's#^(https?://|ssh://git@|git@)github\.com[:/]##; s#\.git$##') || exit 1
url=$(gh api "repos/$repo/commits/$sha/pulls" --jq '.[0].html_url') || exit 1
if [ -z "$url" ] || [ "$url" = null ]; then
  printf 'No pull request found for commit %s\n' "$sha" >&2
  exit 1
fi
case $(uname -s) in
  Darwin) open "$url" ;;
  *) xdg-open "$url" ;;
esac

label: github: open repo
command: repo=$(git remote get-url origin | sed -E 's#^(https?://|ssh://git@|git@)github\.com[:/]##; s#\.git$##') && gh browse --repo "$repo"

label: copy symbol reference
command: printf '%s' "$ZED_RELATIVE_FILE:$ZED_ROW:$ZED_SYMBOL" | case $(uname -s) in Darwin) pbcopy ;; *) wl-copy ;; esac
